newsitem.title: USA: People's Choice TV Corp Q4 full results.
newsitem.headline: People's Choice TV Corp Q4 full results.

text.p: (a) The years ended December 31, 1996 and 1995 reflect the operations of the Detroit and Chicago systems from the date of their respective acquisitions.
The year ended December 31, 1995 reflects an extraordinary gain of $1,197,000 or $.11 per common share.

(b) The year ended December 31, 1996 and 1995 net loss per common share reflects net loss being adjusted by non-cash, pay-in-kind, preferred stock dividends in the amount of $6,123,000 and $4,696,000, respectively.
The three months December 31, 1996 and 1995 net loss per common share reflects a similar adjustment in the amount of $1,582,000 and $1,455,000 respectively.
(c) The weighted average number of shares were computed based on the weighted number of common shares and common share equivalents assumed outstanding.
The shares include common equivalent shares issuable upon exercise of certain outstanding stock options and warrants.
